title: Three hours on autopilot, then the fuel ran out
note: KNOWN POINTS FROM THE AAIASB TIMELINE, JOINED BY STRAIGHT SEGMENTS · THE RED MARK IS CABIN ALTITUDE, NOT AIRCRAFT ALTITUDE

stats.label: holding loop when the F‑16s closed in

_facts: CLAIMS-helios522.md timeline: 09:07 takeoff; 09:12:38 cabin altitude horn at 12,040 ft; ~09:20 last contact climbing through ~28,900 ft; 09:23:32 levels at FL340 (~34,000 ft); 11:49:50 left engine flames out and descent begins; 12:03:32 crash. 121 aboard, all killed; 10:12–10:50 nineteen failed ATC contact attempts; F-16s intercept on the 6th holding loop. The right-engine flameout (11:59:47) is omitted because no altitude is given for it.
